name: Reading contour lines
subject: Geography
example_problem: On a 1:50 000 extract with a 20 m contour interval, identify the river valley, the steepest slope and the spot height, and explain how contour spacing shows gradient.
prior_knowledge: Map symbols and height representation from Gr 8-9 mapwork

importance.summary: Mapwork is Question 3 on BOTH Geography papers, every year: 30/150 per paper in Gr 11 and Gr 12 (map skills & calculations 10, map interpretation 12, GIS 8) - contour reading is the entry point.
